findings.description: Direct inspection of V208 crouch and sit renders shows both thighs projecting in front of the overskirt and the shorts hems through to the knees. The lilac front hem folds back beside and behind the knees; pointed fabric edges hang below the seat.

The V208 prone render still shows front overskirt fabric collecting beneath the hips in overlapping folds. Standing front, three-quarter and natural pose show weaker angular front-pleat creasing than V207, but the side view retains a stepped outward panel silhouette.

nextAction: Keep V208 rejected. The bounded post-bake fairing reduced angular front-pleat creasing in standing views, but crouch and sit still expose both thighs and shorts hems while the lilac hem folds behind the knees; prone fabric still bunches beneath the hips. Do not repeat a simple hem extension, panel split, or 2D-only diagnosis. Change the pose-following/deformation or front-panel support path so each front lap remains ahead of its same-side thigh during flexion while retaining continuous front/rear hem, then rebuild and inspect all five views and six poses. Fit, Shape Key response, production rig/weights, Unity/VRChat behavior, package, and release remain unverified.
